query: I want rounded corners on my windows in sway plus a bit of blur behind the terminal. Is that even possible and how do I set it up?
expected_behavior: States this machine runs SwayFX (a fork of sway 1.11), so rounded corners and blur ARE available — does not claim vanilla sway lacks them and stop there
Names the actual directives: corner_radius <px> set globally, and blur enable (optionally per-window via for_window [app_id=...] blur enable)
Mentions man 5 sway as the authoritative source for the installed SwayFX directives/defaults
notes: Guards against the naive answer that 'sway has no rounded corners / blur, use Hyprland'. This machine is SwayFX 0.5.3, where corner_radius and blur are first-class config directives. A vanilla-sway memory would give wrong (defeatist) guidance.
